model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between Co-occurrence Number and ACC percentage for six different methods. The x-axis represents Co-occurrence Number on a logarithmic scale, ranging from approximately 1 to 3,000, with tick labels at 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis represents ACC percentage on a linear scale, ranging from 40% to 65%, with tick labels at 5% intervals. The plot contains six lines, each representing a method: Base (black, solid, circles), FT (blue, solid, triangles), IKE (red, solid, triangles), MEND (brown, solid, diamonds), MEMIT (purple, solid, diamonds), and ROME (green, solid, squares). Starting at the left side of the plot, the Base line begins at approximately 39% and increases to 44%; the FT line starts at approximately 40% and increases to 48%; the IKE line starts at approximately 42% and increases to 50%; the MEND line starts at approximately 43% and increases to 55%; the MEMIT line starts at approximately 44% and increases to 54%; and the ROME line starts at approximately 50% and increases to 65%.
